sloka: खरश्च निहतो यत्र दूषणश्च निपातितः ।त्रिशिराश्च महावीर्यो मया बाणैरजिह्मगैः ।एतत्तदाश्रमपदमस्माकं वरवर्णिनि ।। ६.१२६.३९ ।।
transliteration: kharaśca nihato yatra dūṣaṇaśca nipātitaḥ ।triśirāśca mahāvīryo mayā bāṇairajihmagaiḥ ।etattadāśramapadamasmākaṁ varavarṇini ।। 6.126.39 ।।

translations.english: Duly permitted, all Vanaras wives and Tara also decorated themselves according to tradition, went around the Pushpaka and looked forward to seeing Sita.
